newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria bourse suspends airline stock after crash.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria bourse suspends airline stock after crash.

text.p: Shares of ADC, the airline whose Boeing 727 jet crashed on November 7 killing all 142 people on board, were placed on technical suspension on Tuesday to prevent their collapse, an official of the Nigerian Stock Exchange said.
The official announced this to dealers during Tuesday's trading, saying the share would stay at 4.00 naira, its closing price on Monday.
ADC shares have slumped 13 percent from 4.60 naira, the price on the day its plane plunged into a lagoon near Lagos.
Nigerian aviation authorities last Wednesday grounded the airline's operations pending the outcome of investigations into the accident.
ADC airlines, a private venture run by a group of Nigerian pilots, is the only aviation company quoted on the Nigerian stock exchange. ($1=80 naira)
